desk:
**BLUF:** In the last 48 hours the listed accounts posted almost exclusively on U.S. political developments under the new Trump administration rather than active conflict zones. The single most important item is Trump’s Truth Social statement confirming Gulf states’ support for continued naval and land pressure on Iran and ruling out any Iranian nuclear weapon.

## MAIN THREADS

### Trump White House briefing with Dana White
- @sentdefender posted video and photos of UFC President Dana White at the podium in the White House briefing room after being introduced by President Trump.[[1]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2119911175815389312)
- @sentdefender and @BarakRavid both noted Trump reading his Truth Social post on Iran during the same briefing.[[2]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2119909057733505059)

### Trump statement on Iran and Gulf states
- @BarakRavid posted Trump’s full Truth Social message in which the President reported an “excellent conversation” with Qatar’s Prime Minister and stated that Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain and Kuwait prefer continuation of the “Greatest Naval Blockade in History” plus the new “Operation Iron Gate,” with Iran’s nuclear weapon ruled out as non-negotiable.[[3]](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2119909386617532551)

### Nvidia CEO and alleged Chinese spy
- @sentdefender reported Trump’s comment that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told him “I had no idea she was a spy” after being honeypotted by a Chinese agent.[[4]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2119914020480102486)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- @sentdefender: Dana White has not yet taken the role of White House Press Secretary (unconfirmed).[[5]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2119912772964110441)
- @sentdefender: Rep. Don Bacon remains unsure about supporting impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and suggests resignation instead (unconfirmed).[[6]](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2119910260819505260)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for any follow-up U.S. action on the Iran blockade or Operation Iron Gate and for clarification on Dana White’s formal role in the administration.
